article.headline: Golden State visits Denver following Murray's 42-point showing
article.description: Golden State Warriors (0-3, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Denver Nuggets (1-1, eighth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Golden State visits Denver following Murray's 42-point showing
article.linkText: Golden State visits Denver following Murray's 42-point showing
article.story: Golden State Warriors (0-3, 15th in the Western Conference) vs. Denver Nuggets (1-1, eighth in the Western Conference) Denver; Monday, 10 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Denver hosts the Golden State Warriors after Jamal Murray scored 42 points in the Denver Nuggets' 141-135 overtime win over the New Orleans Pelicans. Denver went 54-28 overall, 36-16 in Western Conference action and 28-13 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 122.1 points per game last season, 49.5 in the paint, 14.0 off of turnovers and 15.2 on fast breaks. Golden State went 37-45 overall and 24-28 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Warriors averaged 114.6 points per game while allowing opponents to score 115.2 last season. INJURIES: Nuggets: Alpha Diallo: out (wrist), Spencer Jones: out (hamstring), Cameron Johnson: out (ankle), Julian Strawther: out (knee). Warriors: Draymond Green: out (back), Stephen Curry: out (rest), Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Brandin Podziemski: out (back), Al Horford: out (back), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
